name: gameplay
title: Milestone 3 gameplay acceptance T1-T6 (and the Milestone 3.2 T5P) with real windows

checks.name: T1: Hands that start with eliminated players are tracked (the Milestone 2 stall)
T2: A tournament is played to its end; the end is a normal stop
T3: A hand first seen after its opening: untracked, no input; recovery at the next verified hand
T4: Think-time holds: one seat acting on consecutive streets with every control hidden (pre-existing defect fixed in M3)
T5: Two tables: eliminations on both, one window closes; no input crosses tables
T5P: Two tables: table 2 paused by an action its table did not apply, then its window closes (the operator failure, reproduced)
T6: Emergency stop right after an elimination: stop wins, no input, no automatic recovery
gameplay-acceptance: process cleanup (children exited, no live timers)
gameplay-acceptance: exit code matches the result
